notable_absence.finding: Five statistics fields (memory_total_storage, cache_hit_percent, recs_in_mem, recs_on_disk, resident_percent) are tagged [ENTERPRISE EDITION], but unlike index-rest-settings/index.md's storage_mode property - which explicitly states what Community Edition gets instead ('the default (and only) value is forestdb') - this page never states whether these five fields are simply absent from the Community Edition response, always zero/null, or return an error. The Enterprise-only gate is asserted but its Community-side behavior is left undocumented, a genuine content gap rather than a modeling limitation on this project's part.

cross_component_finding: This page's Security section gates GSI statistics behind Query-Service-namespaced RBAC roles (Query System Catalog, Query Manage Index) rather than any Index-Service-specific role, even though the equivalent index-rest-settings/index.md page (this batch's sibling) gates Index Service *settings* changes behind Full Admin/Cluster Admin. Reading Index Service statistics and writing Index Service settings are therefore governed by two structurally different role families on the same service - worth flagging for reconciliation as a real RBAC-boundary finding, not an extraction artifact.
cross_product_finding: None identified on this page - it documents only the Server-side Index Service REST surface, with no Capella- or other-product-facing statement to compare against.
